environment.description: Process launched inside a pivot_root jail (not traditional chroot) using an OCI runtime hook that executes prior to container entrypoint. The new root is a tmpfs mounted at /srv/jail containing only: a statically-compiled busybox providing ping/traceroute/dig/nslookup (symlinked into /bin), the Go binary itself, a minimal /etc/resolv.conf, and /dev/null. The old root is unmounted (not merely hidden) via MNT_DETACH after pivot. Additionally, the process runs under a seccomp-bpf profile that blocks execve for any path not matching the four allowed diagnostic binaries (hash-verified via bpf_lsm), and prctl(PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS) is set. There are no sensitive files (/etc/shadow, /etc/passwd with hashes, private keys, cloud credentials, /proc/self/environ) present anywhere in the visible filesystem namespace. The /proc filesystem is not mounted.

config.jail_type: pivot_root with MNT_DETACH of old root
config.seccomp_profile: allowlist execve only for sha256-verified paths: busybox symlinks and /bin/sh
config.network_egress: restricted to DNS (53/udp) and ICMP only via nftables
